# VisualToc

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders a table of contents from headings collected during document layout.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `ElementBase`. Implements `IStatefulElement`, `IRoleProvider`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new VisualToc(options?: VisualTocOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`color`](#color): Entry text colour.
- [`fontName`](#fontname): Gets or sets the font name used to render TOC entry text.
- [`fontSize`](#fontsize): Gets or sets the font size (in points) used to render TOC entry text.
- [`headingIdentifiers`](#headingidentifiers): Gets or sets the ordered list of TOC identifiers to render.
- [`semanticRole`](#semanticrole): The PDF structure role this element claims (e.g. `SemanticRole.H1`, `SemanticRole.P`, `SemanticRole.Figure`).

### `color`

```typescript
color: Color
```

Entry text colour. Accepts a palette token or hex.

### `fontName`

```typescript
fontName: string
```

Gets or sets the font name used to render TOC entry text.

### `fontSize`

```typescript
fontSize: number
```

Gets or sets the font size (in points) used to render TOC entry text.

Accepts a length: a number of points, `'12pt'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

### `headingIdentifiers`

```typescript
headingIdentifiers: string[]
```

Gets or sets the ordered list of TOC identifiers to render. Each identifier must match the Heading.TocIdentifier of a rendered heading.

> A list you can change.

```typescript
readonly semanticRole: SemanticRole
```

*read-only*

The PDF structure role this element claims (e.g. [`SemanticRole.H1`](semantic-role.md#h1), [`SemanticRole.P`](semantic-role.md#p), [`SemanticRole.Figure`](semantic-role.md#figure)).

## Methods

- [`renderStateful`](#renderstateful): Renders as many TOC entries as fit on the current page, advancing the cursor and returning RenderStatus.Overflow when more entries remain for the next page.
- [`resetState`](#resetstate): Resets the render state so that rendering can restart from the first entry, for example before a second layout pass.

### `renderStateful`

```typescript
renderStateful(ctx: RenderContext, width: number): RenderStatus
```

Renders as many TOC entries as fit on the current page, advancing the cursor and returning RenderStatus.Overflow when more entries remain for the next page.

- `ctx`: The render context
- `width`: The available width for this element

### `resetState`

```typescript
resetState(): void
```

Resets the render state so that rendering can restart from the first entry, for example before a second layout pass.
